name: status-card
title: S1 状态卡 (StatusCard)
description: 状态卡（S1 · 尺寸 S）— 标签 · 状态大字 · 呼吸点

files.content: import { StatusDot } from '@/components/ui/status-dot' import { Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile' import { TILE_THEMES, type Status, type TileTone } from '@/lib/tokens' export interface StatusCardProps { label: string statusText: string description: string status?: Status tone?: TileTone animated?: boolean onClick?: () => void } export function StatusCard({ label, statusText, description, status = 'normal', tone = 'mint', animated = true, onClick, }: StatusCardProps) { const theme = TILE_THEMES[tone] return ( {label} {statusText} {description} ) }
